{{Quote|The Imperial Star Destroyer ''Judicator'' is making orbit this afternoon. You remember my old friend Captain Brandei, don't you?|Tork Winger, to Alexandra Winger|<ref name="A Glimmer of Hope">{{JournalCite|1|A Glimmer of Hope}}</ref>}}
The '''''Judicator''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]], commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]], that joined [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] some five years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Send a message to the, ''Chimaera''. Inform the Grand Admiral that we have engaged the enemy.|Captain Brandei|<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Judicator.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Judicator''.]]

The ''Judicator'' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="HttE-SB" /> It was a 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long warship armed with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. The ship also carried a complement of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], terrestrial troops and various ground vehicles.<ref name="ISB" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the ship incorporated the latest design modification from [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]: targeting computers outfitted with antenna locking, in-line calibration and [[helical-motion extrapolator]]s.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=''Judicator''}}</ref> Due to the limitations placed upon the Empire after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the TIE complement had been reduced from six to three [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="HttE-SB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Civilized? You call what the Judicator did on Janara III civilized?''"<br />"''The High Inquisitor's orders came from the Emperor himself. The Rebel stronghold there&hellip;''"<br />"''There was no Rebel stronghold there, and you know that! You saw the destruction yourself. Innocent children and their families were murdered by your weapons!|Alexandra Winger and Captain Brandei|<ref name="SoG" />}}
In [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], the ''Judicator'' was involved in a [[Raid on Janara III|raid]] commanded by [[High Inquisitor]] [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]] that devasted the city of [[Sreina]], on [[Janara III]]. The ship later traveled to [[Garos IV]] in order to assist the deployment of Imperial forces on this planet.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>

The ''Judicator'' was present in the [[Zhar system]] to protect [[Outpost 327]] but it was not able to prevent [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen's]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rebel fighters]] to [[Mission to Zhar|steal]] the [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> A short time later, the ''Judicator'' was one of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCG" />

In the later years, the Rebellion, now known as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], had become the legitimate galactic government. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Inexorable (Imperial I-class)|''Inexorable'']] served in Grand Admiral Thrawn's [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic after his [[Thrawn's confederation|return]] to the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="HttE" /> The ''Inexorable'' was part of the task force of five Star Destroyers led by the Grand Admiral himself and coordinated by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]].<ref name="HttE-SB" />

[[File:Bpfassh_system.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|Thrawn's fleet]] and the ''Judicator'' approaching [[Bpfassh]].]]

The ''Judicator'' was initially spotted participating in an operation with [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] and ''[[Death's Head]]'' to obtain the moss painting ''[[Killik Twilight]]'' on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

During the Thrawn campaign, it would be sent on an [[Attack on Bpfassh|assault]] of the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]] as part of Thrawn's "hit-and-fade" assaults. After this operation, it would be tasked with traveling to [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]], in the [[Athega system]], to capture [[Plasma-Jet Mole Miner|mole miners]] from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Nomad City]] that would later be used at the [[Battle of Sluis Van]]. This operation, though successful, caused extensive damage to the ''Judicator''{{'s}} hull and put it out of action for a period of time. The ship was eventually repaired and fought at [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]].<ref name="HttE" />

The Star Destroyer would later be present alongside the ''[[Peremptory]]'' at the New Republic's discovery of the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]], where it had been sent to stop the capture of the fleet's [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]]. After the ''Peremptory'' was lost, though, the ''Judicator'' was forced to retreat.<ref name="DFR" /> The ''Judicator'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] during the diversionary [[Battle of Filve|assault]] on the [[Dulfilvian system]] during Thrawn's attempt to capture the [[Ukio system/Legends|Ukio system]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

Following the fragmentation of the Empire that resulted from the final death of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Captain Brandei settled his forces on Janara III and the ''Judicator'' patroled the sector. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Star Destroyer intercepted [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] during a routine mission. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alexandra Winger]] was captured during the skirmish and conduced to Janara III. The New Republic eventually sent forces to [[Battle of Janara III|rescue her]], forcing Brandei to abandon this planet.<ref name="SoG" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the latter portion of the ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' audiobook, namely during the narration of the [[Battle for the Katana fleet|Battle for the ''Katana'' fleet]], ''Judicator'' is erroneously called "Adjudicator". It should not be confused with a Star Destroyer truly named [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']]. 

Although the ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'' and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' defined the ''Judicator'' as an ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer,<ref name="HttE-SB" /><ref name="TCSEW" /> ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' incorrectly classified the ship as an ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer.<ref name="XWA" />
